The `m3e-drawer-container` component — strict per-component surface.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

Usage

Drawers

M3ecomponentbuildHTML
M3e.Element.DrawerContainer.component []
[ M3e.Element.DrawerContainer.start (TypedHtml.div [] [ M3e.text "Start drawer" ])
, TypedHtml.div [] [ M3e.text "Main content" ]
, M3e.Element.DrawerContainer.end (TypedHtml.div [] [ M3e.text "End drawer" ])
]

component is identical to the M3e tab for this example — its content has no required slots or attributes for the component surface to enforce, so it would be a hollow duplicate of M3e. Reach for component on an example whose composition it can hold a guarantee over.

build is identical to the M3e tab for this example — its content has no required slots or attributes for the build surface to enforce, so it would be a hollow duplicate of M3e. Reach for build on an example whose composition it can hold a guarantee over.

<m3e-drawer-container start="" end="">
…
<div slot="start">Start drawer</div>
<div>Main content</div>
<div slot="end">End drawer</div>
</m3e-drawer-container>

API
Types
type Is

The kind row m3e-drawer-container produces (open — composes into any slot naming it).

type Attrs

The closed attribute-capability row.

type Builder

The narrowed pipe-builder this component's M3e.Build.<X> module exposes.

type AttrCaps

The attribute capabilities this component's builder admits.

type SlotCaps

The singular-slot capabilities this component's builder admits.

type ChildAdmittedBy

The context demand this container injects into each child's admittedBy row.

type EndMode

The endMode values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

type StartMode

The startMode values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).
